RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, July 29, 2015/Sravana 7, 1937 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Culture; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Mines; Petroleum and Natural Gas; Steel; Tourism;
Tribal Affairs; Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 15
Construction of modern stadiums
†*91. DR. VIJAYLAXMI SADHO:
Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS
AND SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
construct modern stadiums in the current
financial year to encourage the youth from
rural areas to participate in sports;
(b) if so, the State-wise details thereof;
and
(c) the year-wise and State-wise details
of the stadiums constructed and the funds
allocated during the last three years?
Amendment to the Antiquity Act
*92. SHRI NARESH GUJRAL: Will
the Minister of CULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that any artifact/
furniture, etc. which is more than 100 years
old falls under the purview of ‘Antiquity’
and needs to be registered under the
Antiquity Act; and
(b) whether Government is considering
any amendment to the Antiquity Act
considering that there are millions of such
items in the country and it is almost
impossible to register them with
Government?
Financial assistance to West Bengal
for modernisation of police stations
and jails
*93. SHRI VIVEK GUPT A: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of financial assistance
provided by Central Government to the
State of West Bengal during the last financial
year for upgradation of police stations and
jails;
(b) whether any special assistance has
been provided for education, etc. of children
of women prisoners; and
(c) if so, the quantum of amount spent
thereon?
† Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

32
Rising unemployment
*94. SHRI RAM KUMAR
KASHYAP: W ill the Minister of
LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether due to unemployment the
country's human resources  are being
wasted and the country has witnessed a
rise in unemployment in the last two years;
(b) whether the problem of
unemployment is rising but still many
industries are facing the problem of shortage
of skilled candidates for the companies; and
(c) whether Government has ascertained
the reasons of unemployment in the
country and if so, the details thereof along
with steps taken to reduce unemployment?
Irregularities in Lalit Kala Akademi
†*95. SHRI PRABHA T JHA: Will the
Minister of CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has been
receiving complaints pertaining to the
reported administrative and financial
irregularities in the Lalit Kala Akademi for
past some years;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether the complaints pertaining
to the said administrative and financial
irregularities have been/are being
investigated and if so, the details thereof?
Welfare schemes of oil companies for
SCs/STs/OBCs/Minorities
*96. SHRI A VINASH RAI KHANNA:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) the details of welfare schemes
implemented for people belonging to
Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other
Backward Classes, Minority communities
residing in the neighbourhood of projects
of oil companies;
(b) the company-wise details of funds
spent by Government/oil companies under
the said schemes during each of last three
years and the current year;
(c) whether cases of corruption/
irregularities under said schemes have come
to the notice of Government during said
period, if so, the company-wise details
thereof;
(d) whether Government has conducted
any enquiry in this regard; and
(e) if so, the details thereof along with
corrective steps taken by Government?
Concessions to different sectors of
economy
*97. SHRI C.P. NARAYANAN: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether any financial concessions
have been given to various sectors of
industry and commerce in the form of tax,
duty reductions, etc. during the last three
years, if so, what is the total amount
involved;
(b) what improvement has occurred in
production, export, etc., because of this
and what has been the growth in the
economy; and
(c) whether there is any recent fall in
production in manufacturing and other fields
in spite of these promotional measures?
Implementation of programmes for
forest villages
*98. SHRI P. BHA TTACHARY A: Will
the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the State-wise details of programmes

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, July 29, 2015/Sravana 7, 1937 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Culture; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Mines; Petroleum and Natural Gas; Steel; Tourism;
Tribal Affairs; Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 160
FDI inflows
961. SHRI A VINASH RAI KHANNA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) Foreign Direct Investment (FDI)
inflows during each of the last three years
and current year;
(b) the details of present norms
prescribed by Government for FDI by
companies ;
(c) whether the cases of violation of
FDI norms by many companies have been
reported and forwarded to the Directorate
of Enforcement (DoE) for investigation
during the said period;
(d) if so, the company-wise details
thereof along with action taken by the DoE
in such cases; and
(e) the corrective steps taken by
Government to check such violations of
FDI norms by the companies and to
increase FDI inflows into the country?
Changes in policy on export quota of
sugar to US and EU
962. SHRI SUKHENDU SEKHAR
ROY: Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether there are any changes in
policy relating to export quota of sugar to
USA and European Union announced by
Government in April 2015, if so, the details
thereof;
(b) whether the Ministry of Consumer
Affairs, Food and Public Distribution was
consulted in this regard;
(c) if so, details of response received
from  that Ministry;
(d) reasons behind change in policy, if
any, for exports quota to USA and EU;
(e) details of exporters, if any, engaged
in export of sugar under quota during sugar
season; and
(f) whether changed policy, if any,
resulted in additional benefit to sugar
industry, if so, the details thereof?

226
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Introduction of New Industrial Policy
963. SHRI K.C. TYAGI:
SHRI PRAMOD TIWARI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the steps taken by Government to
introduce New Industrial Policy in the
country during the last two years; and
(b) the location-wise sectors in
which investment has so far been made
during the said period, together with the
amount of investment made in this regard?
Setting up of industrial units
964. SHRIMATI RAJANI PATIL:
SHRI KIRANMAY NANDA:
KUMARI SELJA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of industrial units set up
with the help of centrally sponsored
scheme in the country, particularly in
Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal
and Haryana during the last two to three
years; and
(b) the State-wise and Union Territory-
wise details of investment made in these
units during the above period?
Re-visiting criteria for categorization
of industries
965. SHRI RAVI PRAKASH
VERMA:
SHRI A.U. SINGH DEO:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to re-
visit the criteria for categorization of
industries in the country;
(b) if so, the details and the objectives
for such revision;
(c) whether Government has obtained
the views of various stakeholders and States
before finalization of revised categorization
of the industries in the country; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Complex import regime of India
966. SHRI HUSAIN DALW AI: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether India continues to have a
very complex import regime as per a recent
World Trade Organisation (WTO) report;
(b) if so, the details in this regard with
India's response;
(c) whether Government proposes to
announce a National Intellectual Property
Rights Policy to safeguard India's interest;
and
(d) if so, the progress made in this
regard?
Special package to Chhattisgarh
†967. DR. BHUSHAN LAL JANGDE:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Government
will accelerate the immense potential of
industrial development by providing special
package to Chhattisgarh; and
(b) whether in view of the fact that the
Chhattisgarh is rich in steel, power, cement
and aluminium and located far from sea and
surrounded by seven States, any special
package will be provided to Chhattisgarh
by Government?

227
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Strategy to realise objectives of 'Make
in India'
968. SHRI AJAY SANCHETI: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the strategy adopted to realise the
objectives of 'Make in India';
(b) the progress made so far;
(c) how Government addresses the
issues relating to improving the business
environment; and
(d) whether Government proposes to
change the industrial policy so as to
accommodate and realise 'Make in India'?
Simplifying FDI rules for e-commerce
